name: 19102 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19102 (Philadelphia) has 297 nonprofit organizations. 169 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 160 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19102 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19102 (Philadelphia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 160 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
